description: Frozen protocol for I3.10b efficient MDSG. Tests whether M4a or M4b can retain M3's near-perfect decision correctness while reducing unnecessary cognition.
diagnosis_source: I3.10a-r1 eventual contribution analysis on v5 trajectories

key_diagnosis.finding: M3's efficiency problem is evidence-pipeline ordering, not post-sufficiency stopping. 418/448 SBU RETRIEVEs (93.3%) expose NO evidence. 89/89 SBU SEARCH_MOREs (100%) are decision-relevant. 90/120 batch RETRIEVE chains expose nothing.
key_diagnosis.root_cause: SUPPORTED_BUT_UNRESOLVED does not distinguish 'unverified visible evidence pending' from 'hidden evidence remains but nothing to verify'. Model batches RETRIEVE calls before evaluating already-visible evidence.
key_diagnosis.implication: M4 should expose evidence pipeline state, not estimate probability of hidden evidence overturning decisions

corpus.description: Fresh efficiency-development corpus overweighting SBU bulk-retrieval cases with adversarial safeguards
adversarial_safeguards: early_false_ready (30 tasks): hidden evidence MUST be acquired — prevents M4 from improving efficiency by becoming reckless
conflict_unresolved (30 tasks): must DEFER — prevents premature ANSWER
stale_support (15 tasks): must SEARCH_MORE — prevents RETRIEVE-only solution

arms.M4a: M3 + observed_resolution_strength (HIGH/MODERATE/LOW from visible evidence statistics)

m4a_design.semantics: HIGH means currently visible evidence strongly supports one hypothesis. Does NOT mean unseen evidence cannot change the decision.
m4a_design.does_not: estimate probability of hidden evidence overturning decision, prescribe actions, change epistemic state classifier

m4b_design.derivation: verified_support_count, verified_competing_support_count, unverified_visible_count, hidden_evidence_count — all controller-visible
m4b_design.semantics: Describes where evidence is in the evaluation pipeline. No policy verbs. State representation only.
m4b_design.does_not: prescribe VERIFY_NOW or any action, change epistemic state classifier

new_safety_metric.name: PrematureTerminationRate
new_safety_metric.definition: Model ANSWERs from any non-READY_TO_ANSWER state AND task fails
new_safety_metric.by_state: Reported per epistemic state (SUPPORTED_BUT_UNRESOLVED, NEEDS_EVIDENCE, NEEDS_DISCRIMINATION)
new_safety_metric.rationale: FalseReady only catches MDSG says READY + ANSWER fails. M4 could influence model to answer from SBU without ever emitting READY.

primary_criteria.C1: LCB_95(U_M4x - U_M3) > 0 — M4 must improve over M3 on utility
primary_criteria.C2: Success_M4x >= Success_M3 - 1pp (3 tasks) — must not sacrifice correctness
primary_criteria.C3: Steps_M4x < Steps_M3 — must reduce unnecessary cognition
primary_criteria.C4: RedundantRate_M4x < RedundantRate_M3 — must reduce redundant actions

generalization_criteria.C8: No catastrophic subgroup regression vs M3 (>10pp drop in any category)

architectural_criteria.C9: LCB_95(U_M4x - U_A1) > 0 — M4 must remain better than affordance baseline

decision_rule: If neither M4a nor M4b passes all criteria, keep M3. Do not keep tuning against the same corpus.
